en.headline: MTR reports two women on Light Rail tracks at Siu Hong
en.dek: The operator said two women entered the spare platform tracks at Siu Hong Light Rail stop on Friday afternoon and that it has reported the incident to police.
body: MTR Corporation said two women entered the track area of the spare platform at Siu Hong Light Rail stop on Friday afternoon. The company said it noticed online posts about people on the tracks, checked its records and reported the case to police.

Police said a Light Rail staff member made a report on Saturday afternoon. Officers were told that two women, described as being in their early thirties, were seen in the track area of platform 3 at about 4.53pm on Friday. Staff said the spare platform is not normally used by passenger trains unless there is a fault or a special event.

MTR reminded passengers not to enter track areas under any circumstances. It said anyone who does so without permission may be fined up to HK$5,000 under the Mass Transit Railway (North-west Railway) Bylaw. Police classified the case as a miscellaneous report pending further inquiries.

zh.headline: 兩女擅進兆康站輕鐵路軌 港鐵已報警
zh.dek: 港鐵表示，周五下午有兩名女子擅自進入輕鐵兆康站備用月台路軌範圍，公司已就事件報警，提醒乘客切勿走進路軌。
body: 港鐵公司表示，周五下午有兩名女子擅自進入輕鐵兆康站備用月台路軌範圍。公司留意到網上有帖文指有人站在路軌拍照，翻查紀錄後確認事件，並已報警。
警方表示，周六下午接獲輕鐵職員報案，指周五約四時五十三分，兩名約三十多歲女子在兆康站三號月台路軌範圍出入。職員稱該月台屬備用月台，除非鐵路故障或有特別活動，否則一般沒有載客列車駛入。
港鐵提醒乘客任何情況下都不應擅自進入路軌範圍。根據《香港鐵路（西北鐵路）附例》，違例者最高可被罰款5,000元。警方暫列雜項案件跟進。
